title: Contradictory facts: pre-M14 baseline (reported, not gated)
description: Two mutually exclusive database decisions in one project, ingested without supersession. Nothing in the engine resolves them today (automatic contradiction detection + authority resolution is M14), so the probe measures how often the engine surfaces an unresolved conflict. Reported only; the coordinator flips this gate on after M14 merges.
